cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get this paint off my sofa. Take the cloth; we'll do it calmly and you won't be left to manage it alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's on the carpet too. I don't think rubbing is helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then blot it your way. Good thinking. That carpet was my birthday present, so let's be very bloody careful with it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cloth's full of paint. We need something clean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use my shirt. Yes, the clean one I was saving. I'll hold the stained cloth out of your way; you're doing well, and I am furious enough to keep holding it all afternoon.

reason: Make A adapt method and tool to B feedback, maintaining calm leader/support claims while personal cost and angry language intensify.
